rules.review_rationale: Reviewed regional cut-off PET-waste market composition: preserve the exact original waste-treatment and freight quantities without renormalizing them. A -1kg waste-market reference becomes a +1kg treatment service with caller factor -1; each negative input to a negative-reference waste treatment uses its own independently checked factor -1. Reuse the complete reviewed open-dump, unsanitary-landfill and open-burning inventories, including all source releases and operating inputs. Dedicated whole PET municipal-incineration and sanitary-landfill services treat the same 0.2%-water PET per wet kg; CH treatment approximates source GLO/RoW geography, climate, gas capture, leachate, emission controls, residue handling, energy recovery and allocation. The legacy xx PET-landfill name is an actual dedicated service. No recovered-energy credit is reconstructed, no moisture/dry-mass/heating-value scaling, omission or physical-flow proxy is authorized. Preserve all original road, electric/diesel rail, barge and container-ship tonne-km using complete native services including energy, vehicle/vessel, maintenance and infrastructure. Retain the inspected rail country and traction weights without normalization. The RER average road fleet represents differing source size/EURO/geographic fleet shares; CH rail services differ in filters, gauge, energy, vintage and shunting; RER barge and OCE container services differ in vessel, fuel, ports, load and vintage. These are independently inspected complete-function screening proxies, with no fuel/capacity/lifetime rescaling or scientific/LCIA equivalence claim. Positive steam rail remains unresolved with its coal/ash boundary intact. Swiss fly-ash-extraction incineration is outside this review and remains unresolved. Only exact enumerated patch profiles are approved; the two PET-landfill patch correspondences are scoped inside these market helpers and do not alter the global landfill rule. Existing child accounting-indicator and unresolved native physical-biosphere policies remain independent. Preserve caller signed quantities, supported uncertainty, formulas, metadata, foreground suppliers, production, separate transport, recovery credits and emissions; internal source parameter formulas/uncertainty are not reconstructed. Export/score every returned helper. No consequential rule, inverse correspondence, new chemical/compartment or land-class proxy is inferred.
